about: How the dealer-lab curriculum (source/*.md) becomes this book's parts and chapters. One part per source file, one chapter per ## subsection, except the Strategy Atlas, whose tier subsections are gathered into one chapter per tier. 'heads' names the ## headings a chapter is made from, exactly as the source writes them; tools/spx.py fails if one is missing, unused or used twice. A chapter gathered from several ## headings sets its own title, and each gathered heading becomes one of its sections, named by the words after the dash.
